data.Unnamed: 1: Teachers' and School Heads' Salaries and Allowances

The file includes data for reference school years 2020/2021 to 2023/2024 respectively for teachers and school heads on:
- annual gross statutory salaries (sheets T_1 and H_1)
- proportion of teachers/school heads per salary range (sheets T_1a and H_1a)
- number of years to reach the top of the career (teachers, sheet T_1b)
- actual salaries (sheets T_2 and H_2)
- qualification requirements (sheets T_3 and H_3)
- additional requirements (school heads, sheet H_3a)
- allowances (sheets T_4 and H_4)
- changes impacting salaries (sheets T_5 and H_5)
- decision-making level (sheets T_6 and H_6)

Tabs in yellow correspond to data for teachers.
Tabs in orange correspond to data for school heads.

Links to all Eurostat data used for the calculation of the salaries (conversion indexes for EUR, PPP and HICP) are available in worksheet Eurostat Data (red tab). 
The tool is linked to the Eurostat website and the indexes are applied automatically.
Values in this file are provided in national currency for all available data.
